description: We’re four CSE friends from East Delta University, Bangladesh, passionate about tech, entrepreneurship, and innovation. Skilled in coding, AI, automation, and research, we won our university’s 3-Minute Thesis with an AI project recommendation agent. We learn by doing, value creativity and open communication, and want to build real impact together. We’re looking for proactive teammates in business, marketing and pitching, finance, AI/software, research, or sustainability.
